statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then printf "\033[36m%s\033[0m on \033[35m%s\033[0m • %s" "$dir" "$branch" "$model"; else printf "\033[36m%s\033[0m • %s" "$dir" "$model"; fi
